response.justification: The candidate is an accomplished full-stack/web software engineer with deep experience in TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, and web frameworks, but his C++ experience is minimal — limited to a ~6-month stint at National Instruments in 2014-2015. He lacks demonstrated experience with STL-based architecture, multi-threaded/networked C++ systems, message brokers, MQTT, IEC 62443 SDL practices, or industrial protocols, all of which are core requirements for this role. His skill set and career trajectory point toward web/product engineering rather than systems-level C++ development for industrial automation.
strengths: 15+ years of strong, diverse software engineering experience with senior/staff-level titles
Demonstrated ability to work across many languages/stacks and mentor/teach others (workshops, talks)
Experience with distributed systems, async I/O, and performance-sensitive backend services (e.g., DLang at Sociomantic)
concerns: Virtually no substantive C++/STL experience — only a brief 6-month role touching C/C++ over a decade ago
No evidence of IEC 62443, SDL, industrial cybersecurity, or industrial protocol (Modbus, OPC UA, IEC 61850, etc.) experience
No mention of MQTT, message brokers, or IoT platform work relevant to industrial automation context

key_factors.factor: Lack of C++/STL depth and recency
No industrial cybersecurity (IEC 62443/SDL) or industrial protocol experience
Strong general software engineering seniority and adaptability
